lines: {target}? Cold water steals strength quickly.

Gray waves make distance feel heavier.

{target}? Ice stands tall enough to turn wind mean.

Your best advice for Jagged Peaks sounds simple. Climb with blocks ready and pride asleep.

I'll remember Jagged Peaks as peaks that look cut by a giant axe.
